clips.title: The story
paras: Jahan Hawkwing sends cured hides from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff for leatherworking. The delivery takes you across central Kalimdor and introduces the Crossroads wind rider roost.

Hunters bring game hides and meat to the Crossroads, where Jahan Hawkwing gathers pelts from across the Barrens. The outposts cannot process every raw hide, so he asks travelers to carry them west to Thunder Bluff. Master leatherworkers there can turn the pelts into gear for the Horde.

The trail across the Barrens and into Mulgore is rough, and quilboar and predators threaten anyone carrying cargo on foot. Jahan sends you to Devrak, the Crossroads wind rider master. He can take the goods by air aboard a trained wyvern, linking the Horde’s scattered settlements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff. A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.
Will you take the hides to him for me?
The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider. Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here for a wind rider? You have something to transport?

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you are speaking to the right orc!
